rationale: Christine and Adrish both work at the intersection of healthcare data and AI—Christine as founder of Lattice Health focused on data interoperability, and Adrish as VP of Customer Solutions at Rhino Federated Computing bringing healthcare analytics expertise. Their complementary roles (founder/CEO and customer-facing leadership) and overlapping domain focus on healthcare data systems create natural opportunities to discuss data challenges, customer needs, and potential collaboration.
intro_message: Christine Park, meet Adrish Sannyasi — you're both solving healthcare data problems from different angles (interoperability vs. analytics) and could swap insights on what's actually blocking adoption in the field.
